title: "Blue is my colour. Jai Bhim."
situation: As the founder announces a hunger strike, a woman throws blue ink at him; volunteers hold her until police take her away, during which she alleges assault and raises religious slogans. He tells supporters to stay seated.

lines.text: Blue is my colour. Jai Bhim.
lines.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke

reactionBeats: Supporters rush the stage; he repeatedly asks them to stay put.

buildThis.situation: Someone throws paint at Mira on the stage; whether the crowd charges or sits depends on whether she (or the player at the mic) says something calm and funny in the next three seconds.
